claims: Tyson Fury is widely listed as 6 feet 9 inches (206 cm) tall.
Tyson Fury is a heavyweight boxer.
Some unofficial observers and online discussions speculate Tyson Fury may be slightly shorter, around 6'7" to 6'8".
Tyson Fury's official billed height is 6'9".
Tyson Fury's reach is 85 inches (216 cm).
Tyson Fury's weight class is Heavyweight.
Tyson Fury's nickname is "The Gypsy King".
Tyson Fury's height, reach, weight class, and nickname data is from BoxRec, Wikipedia, and Britannica.
